hed: AAA diesel hits record $6.20; Fri settle still Brent $104.61 / WTI $100.05
dek: AAA’s national average diesel price reached a record $6.20 a gallon on Sunday, Sep. 13, according to Fox Business citing AAA — the highest diesel average on AAA’s recorded table. Friday’s futures settles remain the last verified print used here: Brent $104.61 and WTI $100.05, still finishing a week with gains of more than 8% and both benchmarks above $100. Markets continued to price the dual chokepoint squeeze: Houthi advances near Bab el-Mandeb and constrained Hormuz flows.
alt: Oil refinery towers and industrial piping against a clear blue sky

cl.body: Fox Business, Newsquawk, and EnergyNow frame Sunday’s AAA diesel record at $6.20 alongside Friday’s still-standing settle prints — Brent $104.61 (−$3.02) and WTI $100.05 (−$2.43) — as a refined-product shock layered on a week that still left both crude contracts above $100 despite Friday’s pullback.

cr.body: Fox Business’s diesel-record package and EnergyNow/Reuters week wraps stress that AAA’s $6.20 national diesel average now sits at a recorded high while Friday’s Brent/WTI settles above $100 keep dual-chokepoint premiums — Mocha/Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz tanker risk — embedded heading into Monday’s open.
